destinations.name: Chamonix
destinations.access: 2 days, no blackout dates, half off additional days
destinations.note: Holders receive the 'Chamonix Valley' pass. mountaincollective.com names Grands-Montets, Flégère, Brévent and Les Houches (plus sightseeing lifts). Balme - Vallorcine, Vormaine and Les Planards are added from the lift company's Mountain Collective page (montblancnaturalresort.com/en/mountain-collective-chamonix), whose validity list is dated winter 2025/26.

destinations.name: Megève
destinations.access: 2 days, no blackout dates, half off additional days
destinations.note: Holders receive the Evasion Mont Blanc pass. Per megeve.com that pass covers Megève (Rochebrune, Cote 2000, Mont d'Arbois, Princesse, Jaillet), Saint Gervais, Saint Nicolas de Véroce, Combloux, La Giettaz and Les Contamines / Hauteluce; hence the Evasion Mont Blanc, Megève, Les Portes du Mont-Blanc (Jaillet, Combloux, La Giettaz) and Les Contamines rows.

destinations.name: Mt Buller

destinations.name: Coronet Peak + The Remarkables
destinations.access: 2 days, no blackout dates, half off additional days
destinations.note: Southern hemisphere: use the 2 days in the season before or after the pass (not both). Mt Hutt is 'not officially a Mountain Collective partner' (the page says NZSki honors it anyway, in a paragraph still dated 23/24); left out.

destinations.name: Mt. Norquay
destinations.access: 50% off days only, no included days
destinations.note: Not one of the 27 destinations and no free days. The Banff Sunshine and Lake Louise pages say 50%-off ski days 'are available for use at your choice of Banff Sunshine, Lake Louise and/or Mt. Norquay'.
